required_method_after_inputs_exist: Estimate ID0 pose in the calibrated camera frame with solvePnP using the confirmed physical marker side.
Transform the marker pose into GEOMETRY_SESSION_02_TILE_GRID_WORLD using a validated current camera-to-world relation.
Compose the measured marker-frame-to-base_link rigid transform and apply the explicit yaw convention.
minimum_physical_or_frame_definition_inp: Confirm the ID0 black-square physical side length, resolving 0.175 m versus repository 0.187/0.188 m candidates.
Measure/define the rigid transform from the ID0 marker frame to base_link, including marker center offset/height and axis alignment.
Define which ID0 marker axis is robot forward and the positive world-yaw convention.
current_world_extrinsic_requirement: A validated current camera-to-world 6DoF relation (or a documented, validated derivation from existing intrinsics plus plane geometry) is also required before an elevated marker pose can become a world base pose.
